entries.0f0d5a2422274229: A company that manufactures and sells light-related products, including optical sensors such as photomultiplier tubes and optical semiconductor devices, image measurement equipment, and laser devices.
entries.0fc61162779cc116: This business manufactures and sells laser equipment and laser equipment components.
entries.1d35b10e4db22bbc: This business manufactures and sells optical semiconductor devices. It handles silicon photodiodes for X-ray CT, image sensors for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment, flat panel sensors for dental diagnostic equipment, and other products. The company and Fairchild Imaging, Inc. of the United States manufacture these products, which are sold through domestic and overseas sales subsidiaries. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥79,505 million, the largest of the reportable segments.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.64a0d650b679cfce: This business manufactures and sells image processing and measurement equipment. It handles semiconductor failure analysis equipment, digital pathology slide scanners used for remote pathological diagnosis, digital cameras, and other products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥32,703 million.
entries.747e0ae99c3d7e9b: This business manufactures and sells image processing and measurement equipment.
entries.79f505c11b32d8c2: This business manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, image devices, and light sources.
entries.800399da564df8dd: This business manufactures and sells optical semiconductor devices.
entries.c11602ea0be6be6f: This business manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, image devices, and light sources. It handles photomultiplier tubes for specimen testing equipment, deuterium lamps for analytical instruments such as liquid chromatographs, microfocus X-ray sources for non-destructive inspection equipment for lithium-ion batteries, and other products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥71,906 million.
entries.c4e6e11f59f5ec1f: This business manufactures and sells laser equipment and laser equipment components. It handles the Stealth Dicing Engine, which cuts silicon wafers at high speed and high quality, fiber lasers handled by NKT Photonics A/S of Denmark, and other products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥22,255 million, a substantial increase of 107.7% from the previous year.
entries.d1498728d29646d7: This business is not included in the reportable segments. It includes the hotel business operated by its subsidiary Iwata Grand Hotel Co., Ltd. and the business related to the proprietary products of its subsidiary Beijing Hamamatsu Photon Technology Co., Ltd. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥5,679 million.
